metrics.profile_summary: Senior commercial and technical leader with over 28 years of experience in the textile and industrial solutions sector. Expert in regional business development and commercial management across Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

education.degree: MSc – Applied Chemistry (Specialization in Polymer & Textile technology)

experience.description: Leads regional commercial operations and strategies across Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka, achieving triple-digit sales growth.

experience.role: Head of Business Development & Technical Advisory
experience.description: Led business development and provided technical solutions and application support for industrial customers.
Managed technical services, product application support, and process optimization for industrial clients.
Led quality assurance systems, compliance with international standards, and internal audits.
Supervised dyeing operations, managed production targets, and trained staff on safety and quality.
Conducted textile chemical testing, analysis, and performance evaluation of dyes and auxiliaries.

strengths: Proven track record in regional business growth
weaknesses: No experience with social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, FB)
Lack of digital marketing tool proficiency (Canva, Meta Business Suite)
Severely overqualified for a specialist role
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly experienced senior industrial executive. While he has 'marketing' in his current title, it is B2B commercial leadership, which does not align with the digital content and social media requirements of this specialist role.
